*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 0%,#28151c 0,transparent 42%),var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.65 system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif}

.kicker,.eyebrow{color:#d77b86;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.22em;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:700}
h1{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(3.2rem,7vw,6.8rem);line-height:.96;margin:.8rem 0 1.2rem;letter-spacing:-.045em}
h1 span{display:block;color:#c34c5b;font-size:.55em;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-top:.65rem}
.lead{max-width:620px;color:#d0c8ce;font-size:1.12rem}
.hero-image{width:100%;max-height:78vh;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 20px 45px #000);border:1px solid #51404a;background:#100e12}
.hero-note{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:.6rem}
nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:rgba(12,11,14,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:.75rem max(5vw,18px);display:flex;gap:1.2rem;overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap}
nav a{font-size:.86rem;color:#d8cbd0}
main{max-width:1180px;margin:auto;padding:2rem 24px 5rem}
section{padding:3.2rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);scroll-margin-top:70px}
h2{font:2.25rem/1.1 Georgia,serif;margin:0 0 1.4rem}
h3{font:1.25rem Georgia,serif;color:#e4b2b6;margin:0 0 .7rem}
p{color:#d2cbd0;margin:.6rem 0 1rem}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1rem}
.card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--panel2),var(--panel));border:1px solid var(--line);padding:1.25rem;border-radius:12px}
.card p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;gap:.55rem 1rem;margin:0}
dt{color:var(--muted)}dd{margin:0;color:var(--ink)}
.tag{display:inline-block;border:1px solid #69404a;color:#e7b4bb;border-radius:99px;padding:.18rem .65rem;font-size:.78rem;margin:.2rem .25rem .2rem 0}
.timeline{border-left:2px solid #71323e;margin-left:.5rem;padding-left:1.4rem}
.event{position:relative;margin:0 0 1.6rem}
.event:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-1.83rem;top:.45rem;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#c34c5b;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #2b171e}
.event strong{color:#e5a0a7}
.callout{border-left:3px solid var(--red);background:#1a1419;padding:1rem 1.2rem;color:#ddd2d8}
footer{padding:2rem 24px;text-align:center;color:#918891;font-size:.85rem}
.small{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:760px){header{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:4rem 22px 2.5rem;gap:1.5rem;min-height:auto}.hero-image{max-height:none}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}dl{grid-template-columns:115px 1fr}h2{font-size:1.9rem}}
</style>
